svg.title: Five ways to split a worksheet into pages
svg.desc: One worksheet split into pages in five ways, set through viewOptions.SpreadsheetOptions: ForOnePagePerSheet() gives the whole worksheet on a single page, sized to fit it; best for small sheets (1 page for the 8 x 5 sheet drawn); ForRenderingByPageBreaks() gives pages where Excel's page breaks are, as in its Page Break Preview (4 pages for the 8 x 5 sheet drawn); ForRenderingPrintArea() gives only the print area; each of its cell ranges on a page of its own (1 page for the 8 x 5 sheet drawn); ForRenderingPrintAreaAndPageBreaks() gives the print area, split at the page breaks inside it (2 pages for the 8 x 5 sheet drawn); ForSplitSheetIntoPages(rows, columns) gives a fixed number of rows per page, and optionally of columns (6 pages for the 8 x 5 sheet drawn).
svg.text: ONE WORKSHEET, FIVE WAYS TO SPLIT IT INTO PAGES
the whole worksheet on a single page, sized to fit it; best for small sheets
pages where Excel's page breaks are, as in its Page Break Preview
only the print area; each of its cell ranges on a page of its own
the print area, split at the page breaks inside it
a fixed number of rows per page, and optionally of columns

g.text: fixed rows and columns per page
